faq.title: Common questions
faq.subtitle: What clients ask before we start. If yours isn’t here, ask us directly.

items.a: Focused builds often start around $10k and scale with complexity; larger platforms commonly fall in the $50k–$100k+ range. We price fixed-scope or as a monthly dedicated team after a short discovery call — you always see a clear estimate before committing.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: Most mobile apps launch in 3–6 months; web platforms in 2–5 months; larger corporate or hardware+AI systems in 6–18 months. We set milestones up front and demo progress weekly.

items.q: Who owns the code and IP?
items.a: You do — fully. Source code and IP transfer to you on final delivery and payment. No lock-in, no hidden licensing.
Every release includes a post-launch support window for defects we find together. After that, you can continue with a Maintenance & Support retainer.

items.q: How do you communicate during the project?
items.a: One dedicated channel, a single point of contact, weekly demos of working software, and shared roadmap access. You never have to guess where things stand.
We’re based in Cairo, Egypt, with delivery across the MENA region — overlapping hours with Europe, the Gulf, and beyond.
Yes. We sign NDAs before detailed discussions, and we can keep client names and project details private when needed.

items.q: Can you work with our existing team or codebase?
items.a: Yes. We can embed as a dedicated squad, augment your team with specialists, or take ownership of an existing codebase after a technical audit.
